name: Anna Rose Hopkins
biography: Anna Rose is known for High Maintenance, Dark Night and Shame. Born near Rochester, NY Anna Rose is of Eastern European Jewish and Welsh descent. She moved to New York City to pursue her dreams at age 17, where she attended NYU Tisch School of the Arts, via the Atlantic Theater Company and the Experimental Theater Wing, after which she studied under Uta Hagen's protege Deborah Hedwall and in Los Angeles with Sandra Seacat, John Markland, and Risa Bramon Garcia. Anna Rose is known for an eclectic body of work, from off beat comedy to hyper-realistic drama.
